problem: The onlyppt branch was still coupled to the paper/research pipeline
root_cause: The workflow boundary was unclear; autosearch still contained research code and samples
fix: Created a standalone D:\autoppt project root containing only autopptskills, PPT presentation/stage9 code, the PPT skill, tests, and documentation
reusable_rule: The PPT project root must not contain paper writing, experiments, submissions, or research samples

problem: Quality lessons were scattered across run directories, so later generations repeated known defects
root_cause: There was no stable cross-project improvement ledger or style-handbook entry point
fix: Added improvement/ppt-improvement-ledger.jsonl and improvement/style-handbook.md, and made the quality iterator read them
reusable_rule: Read the ledger before every generation/iteration and record failures, root causes, repairs, and verification evidence afterward
